newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed, gasoline tracks NYMEX rise.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed, gasoline tracks NYMEX rise.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Friday except gasoline which rose after a sharp gain in NYMEX unleaded futures. Naphtha prices eased slightly after Algeria's Skikda port reopened for loadings on Friday morning after closing on Tuesday morning due to bad weather, traders said.
Cargoes in the Med slipped to $225/$227 cif from yesterday's $226/$228, with some traders expecting slightly weaker values early next week.
Gasoline edged up with sharp gains in NYMEX unleaded futures and dealers said high octane supply was tight.
Gas oil prices rose on higher with firmer IPE futures. Premiums were unchanged with Russian offered at quotes +$1.75 cif Med and quotes +$1/1.50 into Genoa but buying interest was threadbare.
Traders said the market for both gas oil and diesel was well supplied.
High sulphur cracked fuel was flat with prices unchanged around $117-118 fob Med.
Low sulphur cracked fuel was also flat with the main Med buyer quiet. Congestion at Milazzo lead some dealers to feel the sector would be slow next week, but others said not.
"They are always on the look out for material," said one.
Prices were steady at $135 cif Italy or a touch below.
Straight-run fuel out of the Black Sea was well supplied as evidenced by cargoes selling below cracked levels. Avails will not dry up until the weather gets noticeably colder, traders said.
